title: Actor
description: One actor's full profile. Every field here maps directly to something visible on their page — edit this file and the page changes, no code involved. Sections left out entirely (no 'training' key at all, for example) are hidden on the page rather than shown empty.

src.description: Path to the image file, relative to the site root, e.g. "/photos/priya-menon/headshot.jpg".

width.description: The image's real pixel width. Used to reserve space on the page before the image loads, so the layout doesn't jump.

height.description: The image's real pixel height. Used together with width to reserve space before the image loads.

alt.description: A short description of the image for screen readers, e.g. "Priya Menon, headshot, looking off-camera".

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, for editor autocomplete. Not used at runtime.

slug.description: The URL segment for this actor's page, e.g. "priya-menon" becomes /priya-menon. Must match this file's name (without .json).

name.description: The actor's full name as it should be displayed everywhere on the page.

pronouns.description: Optional pronouns shown next to the name, e.g. "she/her".

headline.description: A one-line descriptor shown directly under the name, e.g. "Actor, Mumbai & London".

bio.description: The main biography paragraph(s) shown in the hero section. Plain text; line breaks are preserved.

location.description: Where the actor is based, e.g. "Mumbai, India".

photos.description: The actor's photos. headshot is required; fullBody and gallery are optional and simply don't render if omitted.

headshot.description: The primary 3:4 portrait shown in the hero section.

src.description: Path to the image file, relative to the site root.

alt.description: A short description of the image for screen readers.

caption.description: A short caption slug shown under this frame in the gallery grid, e.g. "On set, Monsoon Diaries (2023)".

gallery.description: Additional photos shown in a uniform grid. Omit entirely, or leave as an empty array, to hide the gallery section.

stats.description: Quick-reference facts shown in a horizontally-scrolling strip near the top of the page, e.g. height, playing age range, languages. Omit to hide the strip.

credits.description: Acting credits, shown as a table grouped by medium (newest first within each group). Omit or leave empty to hide the Credits section.

role.description: The character or role played, e.g. "Meera (Lead)".

medium.description: The category this credit is grouped under in the credits table.

year.description: The year of release or production.

director.description: Optional director or production company credit line.

company.description: Optional studio, network, or production house name.

training.description: Formal training and workshops. Omit to hide the training section.

skills.description: Special skills grouped by category, shown as label + level pairs. Omit to hide the skills section.

showreel.description: The actor's demo reel videos, shown in order. Omit entirely, or leave empty, to hide the showreel section. Give each reel a "title" when there's more than one, e.g. "Drama Reel", "Comedy Reel".

title.description: A short label shown above this reel when there's more than one, e.g. "Drama Reel".

youtubeId.description: The YouTube video ID (the part after v= in the URL), e.g. "dQw4w9WgXcQ".

poster.description: Optional custom poster frame (16:9). If omitted, YouTube's own thumbnail is used.

awards.description: Award nominations and wins. Omit to hide the awards section.

project.description: The production the award relates to.

press.description: Press mentions and interviews. Omit to hide the press section.

agent.description: Representation contact. Omit entirely if the actor is unrepresented — do not fill in placeholder values.

phone.description: A phone number in whatever format the agency prefers to publish.

contact.description: Direct contact information shown in the contact block, which always aligns to the page's left spine.

phone.description: A phone number in whatever format the actor prefers to publish.

labels.description: Optional overrides for the section headings shown on this actor's page. Omit any key, or the whole object, to use the default English heading.

credits.description: Override the default "Credits" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

training.description: Override the default "Training" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

skills.description: Override the default "Skills" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

showreel.description: Override the default "Showreel" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

awards.description: Override the default "Awards" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

press.description: Override the default "Press" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

gallery.description: Override the default "Gallery" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

representation.description: Override the default "Representation" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.

contact.description: Override the default "Contact" heading shown above this section. Omit to use the default.
